info.name: Campus Lost & Found Portal - API tests
info.description:
End-to-end API test suite for the Campus Lost & Found Portal.

Run it against a seeded database:
  1. npm run seed -- --force
  2. npm start
  3. Import this collection and the environment, then Run.

Requests run in order because later requests use ids saved by earlier ones.
Covers: health, auth (including privilege escalation), items CRUD with a real
multipart photo upload, the claim workflow, notifications, admin statistics and
the ownership/role security checks.
